name: money-tracker-workspace
description: Full-stack personal finance tracker monorepo (FastAPI + Expo React Native)

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
scripts.lint:frontend: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.install:all: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
